Informed Consent Agreement


Strategic Drivers of Robotics Adoption in the Construction Industry (STIM) — Technical-Enabler Conceptual Validation (Expert Panel)


Please read this consent agreement carefully before you decide to participate in the study.


Consent Form Key Information:

• Participate in an approximately 15–20 minute online expert review of the study’s Technical Enabler construct.

• Review construct definitions and candidate indicators and provide clarity, necessity, and completeness ratings with comments.

• This is a construct-validation exercise, not a survey about your own organization; it involves no engineering build, deployment, or performance testing.

• No information collected will connect your identity with your responses.


Purpose of the research study: The purpose of the study is to establish the conceptual defensibility of the study’s Technical Enabler construct — confirming the content validity, conceptual completeness, and clarity of its three dimensions (Semantic Integration, Adaptive Coordination, and Digital Infrastructure Maturity) and their candidate indicators.


What you will do in the study: You will review the construct definitions and candidate indicators and provide relevance, clarity, and completeness ratings with comments, completed online. You can skip any item and can stop at any time.


Time required: The study will require about 15–20 minutes of your time.


Risks: There are few anticipated risks in this study. Any discomfort is minimal.


Benefits: There are no direct benefits to you for participating in this research study. The study may improve the measurement of the technical capabilities that enable robotics adoption in construction. 


Confidentiality: Your responses will be kept in confidence and reported only in aggregated or anonymized form; an ID number is assigned to each expert.


Anonymity: The information that you give in the study will be anonymous. Your name will not be linked to the data.


Voluntary participation: Your participation in the study is completely voluntary.


Right to withdraw from the study: You have the right to withdraw at any time before analysis without penalty. How to withdraw from the study: To withdraw, close the review before submitting, or email the researcher at humamibrahim@gmail.com within 7 days of completing the review.


Payment: You will receive no payment for participating in the study.


Using data beyond this study: I may choose to use the data as part of a future study. The data you provide in this study will be retained in a secure manner for one (1) year and then destroyed.


Please contact the researchers on the study team listed below to:

• Obtain more information or ask a question about the study.

Dr. Bhargava Krishna

Dissertation Chair / Principal Investigator

Ageno School of Business, Worldwide

Golden Gate University, San Francisco, CA 94105

Email: s.bhargava.krishna@gmail.com


You may also report a concern about a study or ask questions about your rights as a research subject by contacting the Institutional Review Board listed below.

Therese F. Martin, DBA

Institutional Review Board

536 Mission Street

Golden Gate University San Francisco, CA 94105

Telephone: (415) 442-7800

Email: worldwide@ggu.edu
